headline: Gilas Women Beat Hong Kong 90-73, Clinch Asian Games Quarterfinal Berth
seoTitle: Gilas Women Beat Hong Kong 90-73, Reach Asian Games Quarterfinals | FMB News
seoDescription: Gilas Pilipinas Women improved to 2-0 in Group B after a 90-73 win over Hong Kong, securing a place in the 2026 Asian Games quarterfinals.
deck: The Philippines pulled away late to defeat Hong Kong 90-73, improve to 2-0 in Group B and secure a place in the knockout quarterfinals ahead of its final group game against host Japan.
author: FMB News Sports Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: Gilas Pilipinas Women defeated Hong Kong, 90-73, on Sunday at Aichi International Arena in Nagoya to secure a berth in the quarterfinals of the 2026 Asian Games women’s basketball tournament.
The Philippines improved to 2-0 in Group B after previously beating Kazakhstan 86-58.

sections.heading: How Gilas won
paragraphs: Stefanie Berberabe led the Philippines with 21 points, five rebounds and two assists, while Afril Bernardino recorded 17 points and 11 rebounds. Jhazmin Joson added 15 points and Camille Malagar scored 14.
Hong Kong stayed within striking distance through the third quarter, but the Philippines created separation late and finished with a 17-point win.

sections.heading: What is confirmed
paragraphs: GMA News and Philstar independently reported the 90-73 final score and the Philippines’ quarterfinal qualification. The official Aichi-Nagoya organizing committee’s published basketball schedule confirms the Philippines, Kazakhstan, Hong Kong, China and Japan in women’s Group B and identifies Aichi International Arena as a basketball venue.
GMA’s postgame report also carries Berberabe’s comments through Philippine Olympic Committee Media, providing primary-source postgame context from the Philippine delegation.

sections.heading: What comes next
paragraphs: The Philippines is scheduled to face host Japan in its final Group B game on September 22. That game will determine final group positioning before the knockout round.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: The quarterfinal berth keeps the Philippines in medal contention and gives Gilas Women an opportunity to improve on its previous Asian Games placing.
